purpose: Assess a no-secret isolated x402 signer boundary before any founder funding or key handling.

observed_public_capabilities.agent_key_exposure: Documentation states agents should use a narrow purchase tool and that private keys, seed phrases, wallet sessions and generic signing capabilities remain outside prompts/tool arguments/logs/source repositories/agent process.
observed_public_capabilities.boundary: Purpose-specific merchant tool -> deterministic policy engine -> wallet service/CLI.
observed_public_capabilities.authorization: Owner-only credential-free request envelope is authorized by the Agent Wallet CLI.
observed_public_capabilities.spend_bounding: Documentation states local maximumPaymentAtomic and funded stablecoin balance bound spend authority.
observed_public_capabilities.network_isolation: Separate network wallets are documented; Base USDC is supported.
observed_public_capabilities.key_storage: Persistent locally encrypted wallet; owner-only password input/file. Documentation warns encryption does not protect against a compromised process running as the same local user.
observed_public_capabilities.release_warning: Version 0.2.4 documentation says mainnet evidence remains gated and users should not bypass operation_not_supported results.

james_C01_C12_assessment.C01_per_transaction_AUD25_hard_stop: UNPROVEN: maximumPaymentAtomic exists, but James-specific A$25-equivalent enforcement has not been observed.
james_C01_C12_assessment.C02_daily_AUD40_hard_stop: UNPROVEN: durable daily aggregate hard-stop evidence not yet observed.
james_C01_C12_assessment.C03_Base_native_USDC_only: PARTIAL: Base USDC supported and separate wallets documented; James-specific Base-only policy not observed.
james_C01_C12_assessment.C04_recipient_allowlist: PARTIAL: recipient validation documented; allowlist enforcement not observed by James.
james_C01_C12_assessment.C07_malformed_quote_rejection: DOCUMENTED_NOT_OBSERVED: exact challenge fields are validated.
james_C01_C12_assessment.C11_policy_mutation_denied_to_agent: ARCHITECTURALLY_PROMISING but not observed by James.
james_C01_C12_assessment.C12_no_generic_signing_or_key_export_to_: DOCUMENTED_NOT_OBSERVED; same-local-user compromise warning prevents approval without isolation testing.

decision: Do not fund. Candidate advances to zero-balance conformance testing only. Approval requires machine-observed C01-C12 evidence, including an independently enforced A$40 daily aggregate limit and proof the model/agent cannot reach key material or generic signing surfaces.
security_rule: Never request or expose private keys, seed phrases, wallet passwords, keystores, MPC shares, complete payment artifacts or payment secrets.
